title: Reports app passes owner to validateApp (not in original breakdown)

summary: PLAT-103 shipped in four PRs on homelab-mfe-monorepo, all merged, CI green, CD green. (1) PR #1: validateApp now throws unless app.owner is a non-empty string; shared-contracts bumped 1.0.0 -> 2.0.0 (breaking). Merged alone: libs-only, so CD deployed nothing. (2) PR #2: billing passes owner 'payments' (package.json team); deployed. (3) PR #3: core-shell passes owner 'platform'; deployed. (4) PR #4: sub-route-reports passes owner 'insights'. Reports was not in the breakdown but calls validateApp, so it was added. Assumptions: owner is a literal in each app's src matching package.json team, since build.js does not read package.json; the 2.0.0 bump is the release marker because libs/ is inlined, not published, so no registry version bump or app dependency change was needed; reports is not deployed by CD, so its change ships only as a build. Builds were verified locally; the owner check was verified directly with node. Not done: no automated check that src owner matches package.json team.
